caption:
Same $3,000 balance. Two paths. 💸
Pay it off in full this month: $0 interest.
Carry it a year at a 22% APR and make only minimums: you can pay hundreds in interest, and it takes much longer to clear.
Exact cost depends on your card and payments.
Which path are you on right now?
